messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: HIGH 503 rate detected on /v1/embeddings (hosted). 5m error rate: 18% -> paging oncall.

alex: I have the page, looking at grafana now. link: https://grafana.redwood/boards/embeddings-503-trends

alex: 503 spike started ~09:12 UTC, 429s rising too. Top percentile latency is fine.

priya: copying metrics - cluster gpu-pool-3 shows IO wait and kernel queue up. Could be overloaded KV cache eviction causing OOM on runtime?

marcos: I can see a surge from tenant: tenant-acme (identified by header x-tenant-id). Their qps jumped 6x in 2m.

jamie: confirming, logs show repeated "kv-cache-miss + realloc" traces for the runtime on host gnode-17. Sample: `runtime.go:421: kv cache miss, attempting alloc -> OOM`

cassie: Support: acme reported a background batch job that kicked off around 09:10. They say it increased embedding requests. Customer impact: about 3% of hosted accounts seeing degraded embeddings, affected customers flagged in CS.

dave: Product - can we throttle that tenant temporarily? They have burst jobs but SLA is standard.

alex: Proposed mitigations (short list):
- apply per-tenant QPS cap at edge (temp) for tenant-acme -> 15 r/s
- disable heavy embedding endpoints for anonymous/guest tokens via gateway rule
- route lower-priority requests to smaller model variant (embed-lite)
- if needed, evict tenant from GPU pool to a queued backend (degraded but stable)

priya: +1 to tenant cap. I'll patch rate-limiter config in the gateway now.

marcos: I'll stand by to revert if we see collateral. Applying config: `curl -X POST https://edge-api/rate-limits -d '{"tenant":"tenant-acme","cap":15}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP'`

alex: Also turning on surgical key-path cache: `redis-cli -h cache-01 HSET prefix_cache tenant-acme:kv_enabled false` (this prevents large prefixes from blowing memory while we shape)

incident-bot: Action logged: rate-limit rule 1023 applied by marcos at 09:16:42 UTC.

jamie: After cap went in at 09:16:50, 503s dropped from 18% -> 6% in 2min, 429s briefly rose to 9% then normalized. Dashboard snapshot: https://grafana.redwood/boards/embeddings-503-trends?from=09:10&to=09:25

cassie: Notifying affected customers with a brief note: "We're applying temporary rate limits to prevent systemic instability; we'll update when resolved."

dave: Good. Can we keep the cap in for 30m then evaluate? Also want a canary to route a small fraction to embed-lite to validate quality.

priya: I'll schedule canary route: 5% to embed-lite for tenant-acme. Patch done.

marcos: Also increased bucket token replenish for pool-3: `rbacctl adjust --pool pool-3 --token-rate 1.5x` to ease burst penalties.

alex: Observations: after adjustments, GPU load back to normal on gnode-17, kernel queues cleared. CPU steal fell back. Good sign.

jamie: We should also check autoscaler behavior — it didn't spin up extra nodes because burst was short. Filing follow-up ticket to tweak scale thresholds.

priya: handing off to next oncall at 09:35 UTC. I'll keep the rate cap in place until we confirm no further instability.

alex: Handoff notes for @priya -> @alex-next (oncall): state: tenant cap 15r/s, canary 5% to embed-lite, cache short-circuited for tenant. If 503s reappear, escalate to runtime team for emergency evict.

incident-bot: On-call Handoff recorded: from priya to alex-next at 09:35:12 UTC.

alex: request to eng-sre: please add a temporary alert that triggers if 5m 503 rate > 8% after mitigation, paging to oncall.

jamie: Created alert: EMBED_503_POST_MIT_8PCT, severity P2, eval window 5m.

cassie: CS message updated: we told acme we'll review their background job pattern and suggest backoff. They appreciate quick mitigation. :thumbsup:

dave: Postmortem action items: - refine per-tenant burst detection - validate embed-lite quality for canary - autoscaler tweaks for short bursts.

alex: closing note: mitigation successful, leaving rate cap for 30m, follow-up ticket SYS-4523 for autoscaler thresholds and runtime memory accounting.

priya: closing thread in 30m if stable. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Thread marked active -> resolved when last signal quiet for 15m."
